payload.artist_html: Andrea Villa, Juan Abella, David M. Alba, Sergio Almécija, Arnau Bolet, George D. Koufos, Fabien Knoll, Àngel H. Luján, Jorge Morales, Josep M. Robles, Israel M. Sánchez, Massimo Delfino
payload.description_html: (A, B) Premaxilla in anterior (A) and posterior (B) views. (C–E) Left maxilla in medial (C), lateral (D), and dorsal (E) views. (F, G) Left palatine in dorsal (F) and ventral (G) views. (H, I) Left pterygoid in dorsal (H) and ventral (I) views. (J, K) Right ectopterygoid in dorsal (J) and ventral (K) views. (L, M) Left lacrimal in medial (L) and lateral (M) views. (N–P) Left quadrate in anterior (N), posterior (O), and lateral (P) views.
